description: This source file contains PHP classes implementing cryptographic functions for session encryption, specifically 'MD5Crypt' and 'SHA1Crypt', including methods for encryption, decryption, key derivation, and random password generation.

classes.name: MD5Crypt
classes.description: Provides methods for encrypting, decrypting, and generating random passwords using MD5-based cryptographic techniques.

classes.name: SHA1Crypt
classes.description: Provides methods similar to MD5Crypt but utilizing SHA1 hashing for encryption, decryption, and password generation.

methods.name: keyED
methods.description: Performs XOR-based key derivation for encryption and decryption, using either MD5 or SHA1 hash of the key.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a given text with a specified key, producing a base64-encoded encrypted string.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a base64-encoded encrypted string back to the original text using the specified key.

methods.name: RandPass
methods.description: Generates a random 8-character password consisting of ASCII characters, avoiding certain ASCII ranges.
